files.content:
name: 'Blossom Action'
description: 'Run internal ci-cd pipeline related task'
inputs:
  args1:
    description: 'task argument1'
    default: '{}'
    required: false
  args2:
    description: 'task argument2'
    default: '{}'
    required: false
  args3:
    description: 'task argument3'
    default: '{}'
    required: false
branding:
  icon: 'activity'  
  color: 'green'
runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps: 
    - run: chmod +x ${{ github.action_path }}/blossom-action
      shell: bash
    - run: ${{ github.action_path }}/blossom-action ${{ inputs.args1 }}
      shell: bash

# Blossom Action
Github action used for internal ci-cd pipeline
